selection.ownership: Chaser (ChaserHQ), 124 City Road, London, England. International accounts-receivable REST at openapi.chaserhq.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Chaser Open API HTTP Basic (API key username, API secret password) on https://openapi.chaserhq.com, GET /v1/organisation /v1/customers /v1/customers/{id} /v1/invoices /v1/invoices/{id}, Chaser London identity, and dated incident search (ChaserHQ / Chaser Limited + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. chaser.sh usage API is a distinct product. No current unresolved ChaserHQ compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Chaser Open API uses HTTP Basic with API key and API secret on the fixed host https://openapi.chaserhq.com. GET /v1/organisation is the pinned credential validator. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved ChaserHQ compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/organisation used by the pinned validator.
Native Basic uses http.auth.basic with stored apiKey as username and apiSecret as password.
Native category is accounting (source Finance is not in Rust CATEGORIES).
Returns raw Chaser JSON under data instead of the source {organisation} wrapper. Nested filter[...] query objects and additional_fields comma-joins are omitted. The upstream user-agent is not sent.

Maps to official GET /v1/customers. Optional limit (1-100) and zero-based page. Nested filter objects and additional_fields are omitted because the source comma-joins arrays. Returns raw Chaser JSON under data.
customerId is a URL-encoded path segment on official GET /v1/customers/{customerId}. additional_fields is omitted. Returns raw Chaser JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v1/invoices. Optional limit and page. Nested invoice filters are omitted. Returns raw Chaser JSON under data.
invoiceId is a URL-encoded path segment on official GET /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}. Returns raw Chaser JSON under data.
